sql: SELECT f.title, d.company_name, f.published_at FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company d USING (company_key) WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing ORDER BY f.published_at ASC LIMIT 1
reason: The query retrieves the title, company name, and publish date of the oldest open remote-US canonical listing by ordering by published_at in ascending order and limiting to 1.
